text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 24.61767px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #12313b

g.text: 02 | EDA: five figures answer the proposal's core questions

text.style: font-size: 13.01624px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526a70

g.text: TRAIN ONLY: 3,542 valid tasks / 27,367 prefixes; no validation/test EDA. Supplementary figures are post-hoc exploration and did not alter the frozen main experiment; associations are descriptive.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.591797px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526a70
font-weight: 700; font-size: 20.797687px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #12313b
font-weight: 700; font-size: 21.929534px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: end; fill: #26867c
font-size: 12.167354px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #12313b

g.text: Partial response: 45.9% incident vs 8.7% ticket failure. Normal conditions still have 170 failures; template failure spans 0.67%–90.41%. Facet and split by parent family.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.591797px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526a70
font-weight: 700; font-size: 20.797687px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #12313b

g.text: Errors recover; success can be late

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 21.929534px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: end; fill: #26867c
font-size: 12.591797px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #12313b

g.text: 51.21% of successes show explicit errors; 4,031/5,926 read errors recover (68.02%). 77 successes first complete at step 12: an error alone is not a stopping rule.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.591797px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526a70
font-weight: 700; font-size: 20.797687px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #12313b

g.text: Full-run gaps are not early signals

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 21.929534px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: end; fill: #26867c
font-size: 12.591797px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #12313b

g.text: Full-run token medians separate, but step-3 means do not: incident success/failure 4,277/4,226; ticket 4,246/4,289. Final consumption cannot stand in for early information.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.591797px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526a70
font-weight: 700; font-size: 20.797687px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #12313b
font-weight: 700; font-size: 21.929534px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: end; fill: #26867c
font-size: 12.591797px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #12313b

g.text: Within incident zero-error cells, repetition coincides with lower failure (15.8% vs 42.8%); one 50% ticket cell has n=2. This does not show repetition is protective.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.591797px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526a70
font-weight: 700; font-size: 20.797687px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #12313b
font-weight: 700; font-size: 21.929534px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: end; fill: #26867c
font-size: 12.450316px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #12313b

g.text: Eligible incident successes fall to 84 at step 11 while 705 failures remain. Higher late errors among successes are not beneficial effects; always report surviving n.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.025873px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526a70

g.text: EDA SYNTHESIS · FROM FINDINGS TO CONSTRAINTS

g.text: Quality floor: no missing, negative or non-finite values in valid analysis fields; 62 time and 31 token outliers audited and retained.

text.style: font-size: 11.601431px; font-family: 'Arial'; fill: #526a70

g.text: Invalid rates at 50/10 workers: 8.00%/1.03%; date and provider state are confounded.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 24.61767px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #12313b

g.text: 03 | FROM EDA TO THE FROZEN TEST: risk is predictable; loss-free stopping is not

g.text: LR C=1; KNN k=9; fixed/step/never-stop rules

font-size: 13.01624px; font-family: 'Arial'; fill: #12313b

g.text: 5% validation false-stop budget; one frozen test

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13.440682px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #12313b
font-weight: 700; font-size: 32.540599px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #26867c

font-size: 12.308835px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #12313b

g.text: Of 267 failure alerts, 154 occur after first violation; 55 at the same step and 32 before.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 30.418386px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #26867c
font-size: 10.752546px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #526a70

font-size: 12.025873px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #12313b

g.text: Under the same 5% validation budget, KNN and rules select no-stop; the test has only two parent families.

text.style: font-size: 12.167354px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526a70

g.text: Exploratory 48-feature extension (seen test set, not a new blind test): savings 5.39%→5.83%; false stops 4→3; detections by step 6: 14→60. Strict successes remain below baseline; the frozen conclusion stands.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.138453px; font-family: 'Arial'; fill: #12313b

g.text: EDA | Errors are not labels, late gaps are not early signals, and correlation is not causation.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.138453px; font-family: 'Arial'; fill: #12313b

g.text: Study | Runtime signals support risk monitoring and reduce some later waste; violation prevention, loss-free stopping and online gains remain unproven.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.138453px; font-family: 'Arial'; fill: #12313b

g.text: Presentation | Understand failure and recovery first; protect recoverable successes before claiming execution savings.

text.style: font-size: 13.299201px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526a70
font-size: 13.440682px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: end; fill: #12313b
font-size: 12.733278px; font-family: 'Arial'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526a70

g.text: Real LLM + local simulated tools · EDA figures use training data only · Seedream 5.5 created header decoration only, never study figures or numbers
